the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: The operations are defined on cycles by the cited Gysin-on-cycles remark; reduce to the case of an integral closed subscheme W' and its image W; if W' is not contained in D' then W is not contained in D and both intersections are divisor computations whose equality under proper pushforward follows from the cited equal-c1 lemma; if W' is contained in D' then W is contained in D and both sides vanish by construction (source lines 2587-2603)
